copyFailed: Copy failed: the browser did not allow writing to the clipboard.
copied: Copied — paste it to the agent
bridged: An agent is connected (MCP). The buttons below now copy an instruction: paste it to the connected model and it fetches the same prompt the built-in AI uses, generates the result and writes it back to the project (undoable). No AI key needed.
noProvider: Choose an AI provider and enter a key to use the features below; or connect your own agent in the Agent panel.
usingProvider: Using {{provider}}: requests go straight from this browser, not through lumisynth's servers.

theme.title: Theme colors
theme.hint: Generates a dark + light theme from the mood of the lyrics and replaces the current theme (undoable).

segment.title: Word segmentation
segment.hint: Let the AI split words by meaning (affects type hierarchy and how shots are cut). Each line must join back to the original text, otherwise that line keeps automatic segmentation.

direct.title: Scene direction
direct.hint: The AI picks a style pack, energy, families and exit transition for every section. Sections and transitions you set by hand are kept; you can adjust the result section by section in the inspector.

provider.title: AI provider

hints.gemini: Create a key in Google AI Studio.
hints.openai: OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter or a local Ollama / LM Studio. The service must allow cross-origin requests from the browser (for Ollama, set OLLAMA_ORIGINS).
hints.anthropic: Create a key in the Anthropic Console.

provider.keyRemembered: Stored in this browser; never written to project files.
provider.keySession: Kept for this session only; forgotten when the tab closes.
provider.keyOptional: May be empty for local services

agent.connectedHint: The agent can now read and change this project. Every change it makes is listed below and in Output, and can be undone.
agent.step1: Download the local bridge <dl>{{file}}</dl> (needs Node.js 18 or newer, no other dependencies).
agent.step2: Add it to your agent as an MCP server, e.g. in Claude Code:
agent.step3: Ask the agent to call lumisynth_connect; it gives you a pairing code.
agent.step4: Enter the port and pairing code above and click Connect. The browser may ask whether to allow access to the local network.
agent.afterConnect: Once connected, the three buttons in the AI panel ({{buttons}}) turn into "Copy instruction": paste it to the agent and it generates the result with the same prompt as the built-in AI and writes it back, no separate AI key needed.
agent.skillHint: Teaches an agent to write LumiScript scripts (scene arrangement) and settings: syntax reference + workflow. Unzip it into the agent's skills folder (Claude Code: ~/.claude/skills/). Agents not connected to this page can use it to write .lumiscript files that you import in the Script tab.

errors.unreachable: Cannot reach {{label}} ({{host}}): the network is down, the address is wrong, or the service does not allow direct browser access (CORS).
errors.invalidJson: The model did not return valid JSON
errors.notConfigured: AI is not set up yet: choose a provider and enter a key in the AI side bar.
errors.noParagraphs: There are no sections to direct
errors.notJson: The model answered, but not with the requested JSON
